Qur’an & Arabic
Learning Centre

A proposed learning centre for children ages 5–12, with separate Qur’an and Arabic classes. We’re speaking with local families as we prepare the program.

Share your thoughts →

A thoughtful path for every child

Children begin at their current level. Qur’an learning may include reading foundations, Tajweed, memorization and revision. Arabic lessons develop reading, vocabulary, understanding and conversation. Teachers track progress in each subject separately.

Proposed class times

MorningQur’an 9:00–10:30 am, then Arabic 10:30 am–12:00 pm.
AfternoonQur’an and Arabic run at the same time, 3:00–5:00 pm, in separate classes.
EveningQur’an and Arabic run at the same time, 5:10–7:10 pm, in separate classes.

Classes are planned for five days each week. Each subject batch will have up to 10 learners. Final schedules and opening details are still being confirmed.

Proposed fees

Monthly tuition is ৳4,000 for Qur’an or Arabic, or ৳6,000 for both subjects.

The one-time admission fee is ৳3,500 per child. A deposit of ৳1,750 per child reserves a place in the selected classes and counts toward the first month’s tuition.

These amounts are planning proposals and are not final or approved. Iqra is not accepting enrollment yet.

Placement and getting started

Placement assessment and one trial class are part of the current plan. Teacher names and qualifications, classroom facilities, child supervision, authorized pickup, emergency response and a parent complaint route are still being confirmed. We will publish verified details before enrollment opens. Iqra is not accepting enrollment.
